description: backend.rs: SetErrorType has Display, but SetError itself has no Display impl. SetError is the per-item error returned in notCreated/notUpdated/notDestroyed maps. Library users logging or propagating a SetError must manually inspect fields; they cannot write .to_string() or format\! on it. A Display impl that produces e.g. 'invalidProperties (properties: [name, role])' would complete the error type and satisfy the usual Rust convention that public error types implement Display.
title: SetError missing Display impl
